# ui::PopupClosingArgs

Header: `winui/ui/Element.hpp`.

What a popup's `on_closing` gets: why it is closing. The handler returns [ui::Cancel](../core/namespace-ui.md#cancel) to keep it open.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reason` | `PopupCloseReason` | `PopupCloseReason::Programmatic` | Why it is closing. |
